dedupe_keys.name: dataset experimental studies on rehabilitation techniques in masonry walls

description: Dataset - Experimental studies on rehabilitation techniques in masonry walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Diana Ramirez Quintero, National Autonomous University of Mexico (unam.mx). This project includes information of 94 specimens consisting of masonry walls that were experimentally tested by various authors and rehabilitated using different techniques, including jacketing with welded wire mesh, jacketing with steel bands, steel plates, FRP bands, polypropylene bands, textile mortar mesh, and fiber-reinforced mortars. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-r7e4-6r61. Keywords: Rehabilitation, masonry, seismic retrofit. Published 2024-04-05. Facility named: National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
